subject: Status: dedup numbers, protocol draft, rater-agreement caveat
body:
Hi both,

Status. Bilal's de-dup pipeline is in dry-run and the numbers justify the schedule slip: 3.1% of candidate pairs are mirror/redirect duplicates, and they are heavily concentrated in the label-2 (most similar) bucket - exactly where inflation would have hurt most. Production run lands 6/19 as planned.

Eval protocol draft is circulating: we report accuracy and AUC on the majority-vote labels, with the 0/1/2 scale collapsed to binary at two operating points so teams cannot cherry-pick a threshold.

Caveat I want on record: rater agreement is solid on 0-vs-2 but noticeably weaker between adjacent labels (0-vs-1, 1-vs-2). Where the 3 raters split three ways there is no majority at all - about 2% of pairs - and we drop those, documented. Teams should treat small deltas on the middle band as noise, and the protocol doc says so.

Baselines on track for 7/3; dual-encoder one is already running.

Quentin
